svg.aria-label: Two-panel schematic: a person with arms folded picks up the two ends of a straight rope; after uncrossing the arms an overhand knot appears in the rope.

g.text: Cross your arms, then pick up
one end of the rope in each hand.
the knot passes into the rope.
Your two arms, your body and the rope form one closed loop.
While you hold on, that loop's knot type cannot change.
